sources.snippet: Overview distilbert-base-uncased is a smaller, faster transformer model created by distilbert through knowledge distillation from BERT base. It was pretrained using three objectives: distillation loss to match BERT base probabilities, masked language modeling (MLM) where the model predicts randomly masked tokens in bidirectional context, and cosine embedding loss to align hidden states with ...
